subject: Edge fabric pinning + post-deploy verification for AcmeCloud private deployment
messages:
From: Claire Dufresne <claire.dufresne@acmecloud.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acmecloud.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge fabric pinning + post-deploy verification for private run

Team —

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. As discussed, AcmeCloud will be cutting traffic to the private deployment this Wednesday (05/05) at 02:00 PDT. Before we flip, our security and network teams want:

- A final snapshot of the firewall rules you intend to apply (egress, ingress, management)
- A short checklist we can run in the first 30 minutes post-flip to validate reachability to control plane and KV cache priming
- A simple accept/reject criteria for the first-hour rollout in case we need to revert

Can you confirm you'll attach the runbook and a short post-deploy CSV with the smoke vectors we validated? I can also pull together an emergency rollback ticket on our side.

Claire
VP Ops — AcmeCloud
claire.dufresne@acmecloud.com

--
Attached: none (requested)
From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dufresne <claire.dufresne@acmecloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 18:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge fabric pinning + post-deploy verification for private run

Claire —

Good plan. We have prepared the runbook and the smoke test vectors; attaching final artifacts to this thread. Highlights below so your ops folks can triage quickly: 

1) Firewall snapshot: fw_rules_snapshot_20270503.txt (attached) — shows expected ingress only from AcmeCloud control IPs (x.x.x.0/24) and management access allowed from the jump hosts. No open management ports to internet.

2) First-30m checklist (top of redwood_runbook_v2.1.pdf):
   • BGP session establishment check to the edge router (2m)
   • Control-plane TLS handshake sampled from three regions (5m)
   • KV cache warmup (send warmup prefix set 1) and verify hit rate > 70% (10m)
   • Token-level latency spike check: sample 5 requests at 95th pct threshold (10m)
   • Basic embed/serve health check: generate 50 short requests and confirm no 5xx (3m)

3) First-hour accept/reject (in runbook):
   Accept if: control-plane latency within SLA band, KV hit rate >= 60%, no sustained 5xxs > 1% of requests, error budget not exhausted for route.
   Reject/rollback if: BGP flaps > 2 times in 10 minutes, control-plane unreachable from >1 region for >5 minutes, or sustained 5xxs spike >5% for 15 minutes.

4) Post-deploy artifact: smoke_results_20270504.csv — a short dump of the synthetic checks we ran in staging using the same prefix sets/keys.

We will be on the bridge from 01:30 PDT for the handover and will run the checklist live. If you want us to kick the rollback automatically on certain triggers, we need the go/no-go signal from your incident commander.

Attaching: redwood_runbook_v2.1.pdf, fw_rules_snapshot_20270503.txt, smoke_results_20270504.csv

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge fabric pinning + post-deploy verification for private run

Quick internal notes before the bridge:

- I updated the runbook step IDs to be idempotent (RB-1 .. RB-12) so our automation can re-run specific checks without confusing the human steps.
- Monica: can you stand by to take the KV cache priming step? I'll run the control-plane TLS probes.
- Marissa: keep an eye on route-based telemetry and be ready to flip the route to fallback-region if latency moves.

Also pinged Aditya privately to make sure the escalation channel to infra is warmed up in case we see any fabric MTU issues.

Laura
From: Ops Team <ops@acmecloud.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Dufresne <claire.dufresne@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 02:41:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Edge fabric pinning + post-deploy verification for private run

Sean/Laura —

We cut traffic at 02:00 PDT per plan. Initial observations from the first 22 minutes (we attached a condensed CSV):

- BGP sessions established from both spine routers within 90s.
- Control-plane TLS handshakes succeeded from three vantage points at ~120ms median.
- KV warmup: after sending prefix set 1 we observed a KV hit rate climb to 68% within 8 minutes.
- 5xxs: transient spike to 1.8% at 02:17 for ~3m, returned to baseline. No flooding or persistent errors.

We did see a small management plane alert on the second jump host (SSH auth failure loop) — unrelated to fabric but we closed it.

Attached: smoke_results_20270504.csv (condensed)

Claire — you have the go/no-go call, but based on the criteria in the runbook this looks within acceptable bands so far.

—ACME Ops
From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dufresne <claire.dufresne@acmecloud.com>, ops@acmecloud.com
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge fabric pinning + post-deploy verification for private run

Thanks for the quick readout and the condensed CSV. Notes from our side:

- The transient 5xx spike aligns with a scheduled upstream cache revalidation in Acme's control plane. We flagged it in telemetry and confirmed it did not propagate to the fallback region.
- We will push a minor ACL tweak (tighten management access to the second jump host) and re-scan; patch will be non-disruptive.
- Based on the runbook pass and your early-hour metrics, Redwood recommends: greenlight moving full traffic to private route with phased ramp (25% -> 60% -> 100% over 4 hours).

If Claire agrees, Monica and I will remain on the bridge for the ramp and produce a final post-ramp artifact and a one-hour post-mortem note.

—Sean
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
